# AI Social Media Platform - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Daily AI-driven Social Media Analyzer and Auto Posting Platform

## Architecture
- Backend: NestJS + TypeScript
- Frontend: React + TypeScript  
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Cache: Redis
- Queue: Kafka/RabbitMQ
- Infrastructure: Docker + Kubernetes

## Key Modules
1. User & Account Management
2. Platform Integration (LinkedIn, X, Instagram)
3. Analytics Engine
4. AI Orchestration Engine
5. Media Generation Engine
6. Scheduler Service
7. Publishing Workers
8. Feedback & Learning Engine

## Development Guidelines
- Follow NestJS best practices
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Implement comprehensive error handling
- Add logging for all critical operations
- Follow REST API conventions
- Use environment variables for configuration
